newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel says Germany must meet EMU budget target.
newsitem.headline: Waigel says Germany must meet EMU budget target.

text.p: Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Tuesday it was important for Germany to meet the budget deficit target for European economic and monetary union (EMU), and that a discussion of loosening the target was dangerous because it could arouse expectations in other countries.
Germany and all aspiring EMU participants must reduce their deficits to three percent of gross domestic product, Waigel said after a meeting of the Christian Democrats' parliamentary faction.

It was dangerous to discuss "the figures that follow the decimal point," Waigel said, referring to the question of whether a country could still qualify for EMU if its deficit were 3.1 percent or more.
Such a discussion could lead to expectations that the criteria would be loosened, he said.
